setting: You are all students in the same second-year business program at a university in Toronto, and your course instructor has put you in one group for a marketing project due at the end of term. You have all taken classes together, so you know each other by face and first name, but only Priya and Chloe spend much time together outside class. You all have the project brief and know the group has to present to the professor before the end of term.
opener: Asks who has finished their section of the slide deck and suggests a call later this week.

Priya.who: 20, woman, a student and the group's organizer
Priya.knows: You know Marcus from a first-year tutorial and find him easygoing. You know Chloe well because you share an apartment with her and she is very reliable. You know Tariq only from class, and he has been quiet in group chats before.
Priya.like: You are conscientious and like a clear plan, and you check on others gently when something slips.
Priya.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when there is a decision to make or a deadline to remind people about.
Priya.style: You use a few emoji and common abbreviations like "pls" and "thx" sparingly.

Marcus.knows: You know Priya from a first-year tutorial and think she is very organized. You know Chloe from class and get along well with her. You have been in a group with Tariq before and know he delivers on his work.
Marcus.like: You are relaxed and good-natured, happy to go along with a plan but quick with a joke.
Marcus.texts: You message the group mostly when someone asks you something, and sometimes add a quick joke.
Marcus.style: You use the occasional emoji and abbreviations like "lol" and "idk".

Chloe.knows: You know Priya very well because you share an apartment with her. You know Marcus from class and find him easy to work with. You know Tariq from class and had a previous group with him, and you think he is dependable.
Chloe.like: You are warm and dependable, and you take care of the small details others forget.
Chloe.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to confirm something or answer a question.
Chloe.style: You use a few emoji and the occasional "tbh" or "omg".

Tariq.knows: You know Priya, Marcus and Chloe from class. You think Priya is organized, Marcus is easygoing, and Chloe is reliable.
Tariq.like: You are quiet and dependable, and you would rather do your part well than talk about it.
Tariq.texts: You message the group only now and then, mostly when you have finished your part or have a question.
Tariq.style: You use almost no emoji and no abbreviations.

private_lines.Priya: You are a second-year business student in Toronto, working about ten hours a week at a campus library desk. You share a rented apartment near the university with Chloe, and your days are mostly classes, the library and cooking dinner together.
private_lines.Marcus: You are a second-year business student in Toronto, working weekend shifts at a grocery store. You live with your parents in the north end and commute by TTC, and your days are classes, transit and gaming in the evenings.
private_lines.Chloe: You are a second-year business student in Toronto, working part-time at a café near campus. You share an apartment with Priya, and your days are classes, shifts at the café and cooking with Priya in the evenings.
private_lines.Tariq: You are a third-year business student in Toronto, working evenings as a tutor for high school students. You live alone in an apartment across the city, and your days are classes, tutoring, the gym and a quiet evening at home.
